title: Great app, would love to have 2 things changed
body:
It’s a great app, but what’s holding me back to use it is that the widget on the access screen is showing all selected habits and not only the selected habits that are due that day. Would be great to have a widget that shows only the habits that are due today. 

Additionally, one can now accidentally press the widget icon and mark it as completed. Would great to have a setting that you can choose what touching the icon does. I would opt to bring me to that habit in the app where I can mark the habit as done (or run the habit if it is a habit with a timer).

Thanks for considering the above.

title: LOVE
body:
I absolutely love this app. The dev is also constantly improving it and adding new features. I am currently on the testflight version (read app description on how to join). 

My favorite new addition are:
1. connection to health app (!!!) 
and 2. that you can choose what a fast swipe will count as (complete, add value,…) 
Eg: I need to hydrate my face twice every day. Swiping used to complete both at the same time, but with this new feature, I selected “add value: 1” for fast swipe and it works amazingly now Go Dave Go 😍

title: Nice app to track habits, full of features
body:
Great job with the app. It does what it sets out to do, with a clean interface and many features to enjoy and use.

My suggestions: 
1. improve the icon selection for habits (add more icons, make the selection more intuitive, e.g with icon categories)
2. add more home screen widgets. For example, one detailing the streak for a certain habit, or for general stats (perfect days, …). But with text, so that the widget doesn’t get too visually cluttered
